verdict.rationale: LightSprint's own docs describe saving skill files such as design.md for the design system and review.md for code standards, which AI agents can pull from. That is a first-party mechanism for convention context files, and the product separately claims its changes fit existing team patterns. The evidence is a single marketing line with no documentation of file format, location, or how agents apply the files during planning and code generation. Missing for 10: detailed docs on context-file setup and format, evidence these files shape plans as well as code, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can add a context file describing my codebase conventions so agents generate more relevant plans and code

citations.quote: Save a skill once design.md for your design system, review.md for code standards. Every teammate or AI agent can pull from it instantly.
ships changes that fit the patterns your team already uses.
